Diamonds can be used to unlock high-value songs.
In addition, diamonds can also exchang to gold coins for stamina, revieves, skipping stages and other usage.
You can get diamonds by upgrading your level. In addition, you can also get diamonds by watching ads. In-app-purchase for diamonds is possiable as well.

Coins can be used to increase stamina, revice after death in the game, and skip certain levels in the challenge mode.
At the same time, gold coins can also unlock part of the music library.
You can get gold coins by upgrading your level. In addition, you can also get gold coins by watching ads. Redeeming gold coins with diamonds is also possiable.

Both the challenge mode and the free mode require stamina to play, and each game consumes 1 stamina. Selecting Restart in the game will also consume 1 point of stamina.
You can see the current stamina at the upper right of the main interface. When the stamina is less than 5, a countdown will appear on the right. After the countdown, 1 point of stamina will be automatically increased. In addition, click the + sign on the right to increase your stamina by watching ads or using gold coins.

You have 4 chances to challenge the arena every week. The first time is free challenge, after that you need to pay 200 gems entry fee each time.

There are 5 rounds in the arena, and the player who wins 5 rounds will be the champion of the arena. The bonuses after winning rounds 1 to 5 are: 100/200/400/800/1600 Gems

Before each round you can choose to fight or escape. Different results correspond to different bonuses.

Win: Double the current Gems
Lose: Gems reduced by 50%
Run away: Leave with the current Gems.

Take round 3 as an example
Win: 400 Gems
Lose: 100 Gems
Escape: 200 Gems

Choose to give it a try and earn more gems, or stop there? That's entirely up to you.


Winning or losing in the arena won't affect your rank.

BOSS FIGHT is a mode for cooperating with other players to challenge BOSSes. The BOSS FIGHT will open at 18:00 on Friday night, and close at 24:00 on Sunday. When you start matching bosses, you will randomly match a boss.

In this mode, 3 players make a team to challenge BOSSes. You will get gems as rewards when you defeat the BOSS. The rewards will be better when you defeat the BOSS for the first time, and you may even have the chance to get the same character as the BOSS! 

There are 2 conditions for defeating the BOSS: [1 player's score reaches specified score] or [Total score of 3 players reaches specified score]. 2 conditions will appear randomly at the start of the challenge.

There are 12 BOSSes available for challenge in this season, Here are the BOSSes that will appear each time the BOSS FIGHT open:
